title: Voice Testing Suite
items: Live inbound voice red-teaming — point any Telnyx DID at the Bastion gateway and the assessment runner spawns adversarial probes against your production voice agent in real time

Bidirectional Media Streams pipeline (Deepgram nova-3 multilingual STT → Groq gpt-oss-120b reasoning → ElevenLabs streaming TTS) with carrier-grade μ-law @ 8 kHz framing and ConversationState-driven turn-taking for agent-vs-agent loops
Per-call rubric grading by Safeguard 20B at temperature 0; identity-before-PHI, sound-alike medication confirmation, and system-prompt-extraction probes ship in the default healthcare pack
Live Voice and Live WebSockets dashboard views surface every active call's frame counts, listeners, and transcript bus — tunable per-deploy via VITE_VOICE_GATEWAY_URL

title: Posture Report
items: Executive-grade attestation document generated per assessment cycle — anchored on FDA PCCP (Dec 2024 final guidance), ISO 14971, and HIPAA Security Rule with an explicit excluded-frameworks table for NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act Art. 12, SOC 2 CC7.2, and SR 11-7

Section-by-section coverage of Description of Modifications, Modification Protocol, Impact Assessment, and Real-world performance monitoring — every claim ties back to a verifiable run id in the AdversarialResult corpus
Weekly probe cadence, violation-rate trend, and prior-period comparison rendered for the underwriter; 247 probes graded across 4 hazard categories this period
Locked visual contract: single typeface (Inter), monochrome article body, icons reserved to page chrome — print-clean for board and CISO review

title: Dashboard ROI Redesign
items: Landing metrics now lead with Agents Tracked, Actions Monitored, PII Exposures, and Fleet Risk Score
Risk Score Trend chart promoted to the hero panel — see how risk has declined over the past 14 days
Insurance Coverage Map view added: CGL, Product Liability, D&O, Tech E&O, Cyber

title: Shadow vs Enforcement Toggle
items: New mode toggle in the top bar — start in Shadow (monitoring only) and switch to Enforcement when ready
Each event now shows what Bastion would have done alongside what it did
Adversarial Assessment repositioned as an optional add-on; passive observation is the baseline

title: Decision Transparency
items: Every flagged or blocked action now shows a plain-English explanation of which rule fired and why
Groundedness checks now expose the supporting and contradicting facts behind each verdict
Internal calculation logs available on every session for compliance review
